risk_summary: The excerpt is relatively transparent and highly quantified, with detailed year-over-year asset, loan, deposit, earnings, capital, and credit-quality metrics. Risk disclosures rely on standard accounting-estimate caveats, particularly for loan-loss allowances and deferred tax assets, while nonaccrual loans increased and loan-loss reserves declined as a percentage of loans. Overall tone is confident and positive, supported by earnings growth, strong deposit funding, and capital ratios well above regulatory standards.
